name: Citizenship for Croatian Emigrants and Their Descendants (diaspora)

qualifying_event.description: Available to Croatian emigrants (iseljenici) and their descendants, and to members of the Croatian people (diaspora) demonstrating cultural and national affiliation to Croatia, without the ordinary 8-year residence requirement applied to standard naturalisation.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentation of Croatian ethnic/national origin or emigrant lineage; evidence of ties to Croatian culture, language, or national tradition; no need to reside in Croatia first.

requirement_groups.name: Croatian emigrant or descendant / diaspora affiliation

requirements.blocker_text: Requires recognised status as a Croatian emigrant or descendant of an emigrant, or as a member of the Croatian people demonstrating cultural/national affiliation, assessed without a residence-in-Croatia requirement.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of Croatian emigrant lineage or diaspora/national affiliation

sources.title: Government of the Republic of Croatia (gov.hr) -- Acquiring Croatian citizenship (emigrants and diaspora ground)
Narodne novine (Official Gazette of the Republic of Croatia) -- 2019 amendment to the Croatian Citizenship Act, Article 16 diaspora provisions

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Croatia's initial build. Kept as its own route rather than folded into hr_naturalisation or hr_citizenship_descent because it is a genuinely distinct legal ground (Article 16 of the Citizenship Act, per narodne-novine.nn.hr) available WITHOUT the 8-year residence test that defines standard naturalisation, and without requiring the direct parent-child relationship that defines the descent route -- it instead applies to a broader diaspora/emigrant-lineage population. HONEST GAP: the precise evidentiary bar for 'affiliation to the Croatian nation' (how distant an ancestor qualifies, what documentation the Ministry actually accepts) was not fully specified in the tier-1 sources fetched in this pass -- qualifying_event is modelled as a single assessed fact rather than a detailed, possibly-invented checklist. This route is genuinely selection_method 'assessed' (Ministry discretion involved per gov.hr's general framing of naturalisation grounds), not 'automatic' like direct descent.
